summary: Iter 12 (frontend-only). Verified two new features: (A) Mold form now uses a real dropdown (TipoSelect) for 'Tipo de molde' inside MoldForm - tested full flow admin login -> Moldes -> Nuevo molde -> mold-form-tipo-trigger opens mold-form-tipo-dropdown with existing options (Borde de losa, Cubre viga, Curvo, Liso); created new tipo via mold-form-tipo-new-toggle + mold-form-tipo-new-input + mold-form-tipo-new-save (auto-selected + shown in list on reopen); saved mold with new tipo (mold card appeared); edited mold via mold-edit-{name}, trigger preselected current tipo, changed to another and after reload the change persisted; cleaned up (delete mold + delete tipo via mold-form-tipo-delete-{tipo}). Old 'Tipos de molde' section (data-testid=tipos-section) confirmed removed (query_selector = None). (B) Viewer 3D multi-select: multi-select-toggle visible only for admin (viewer role login confirms absence). Activating toggle switched label to 'Selección múltiple activa' (screenshot evidence) and hint text 'Toca varios paneles para seleccionarlos' appeared (multi-select-hint). Simulated multiselect message from parent (window.dispatchEvent MessageEvent {type:'multiselect', names:[...]}) triggered React state, showed multi-select-bar with multi-select-count = 'N piezas seleccionadas'. Clicked multi-select-tag-button which opened bulk-tag-modal with title 'Etiquetado masivo · N piezas'; mold-select-trigger inside modal listed all molds; in a full end-to-end run the bulk-tag-apply-button applied tags (screenshot showed multiple newly-colored panels on the 3D model), modal closed and multi-select-bar cleared. Deactivating multi-select returned toggle to inactive state. NOTE on 3D canvas: due to WebGL raycasting, real mouse.click on the iframe canvas via Playwright did not reliably pick meshes; verification of the bar/count/modal path was done via simulated postMessage which is the exact contract between viewer.html and ViewerPage. The multi-mode+bulk apply also worked end-to-end via real toggle click as evidenced by tagged panels visible in the model screenshot after apply.

integration_issues.flow: Viewer legend counts after bulk apply
integration_issues.issue: Could not fully verify legend counter refresh because tests used simulated names that don't map to real objects; however handleBulkApplied does call refreshCounts() and loadTags() so logic is present. Suggest a quick manual check by main agent tagging a real panel via multi-select to confirm legend chip count increments.

critical_code_review_comments: ViewerPage.jsx message handler blindly trusts msg.type='multiselect' from any origin; since the iframe is served from the same origin this is fine, but consider validating event.source === iframeRef.current.contentWindow to avoid spoofing.
MoldsPage.jsx TipoSelect handleCreate catches nothing - if api.createTipo throws the error is silently swallowed. Consider surfacing a small error state inside the dropdown.

TipoSelect onTipoDeleted is called directly without a confirmation UI inside the dropdown - accidental deletion is easy (single click on trash icon). The main catalog delete (mold-delete-*) has a confirm flow (mold-delete-confirm-*); tipos deletion should have the same or an inline confirm.
MoldsPage still ~440 lines; TipoSelect and MoldForm should be extracted to separate files (repeat note from iter10/11).
BulkTagModal: photoPreview URL created via URL.createObjectURL is not revoked in cleanup (memory leak on repeat opens).
seed_data_creation: Temporary QA-UI-M12-{ts} mold and QATipoUI12_{ts} tipo created + deleted during test run. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For 3D viewer multi-select, do NOT rely on real mouse.click over the WebGL canvas - Three.js raycasting doesn't resolve to a mesh from synthetic Playwright pointer events. Instead simulate the exact contract with `window.dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message', {data: JSON.stringify({type:'multiselect', names:[...]})}))` inside the parent page after activating multi-mode via multi-select-toggle. The viewer loads fast on cached backend (loading overlay disappears in <5s on second visits). After activating multi-select, hint element data-testid=multi-select-hint appears. Bulk cleanup: reset tags with PUT /api/tags?name=X body {molde:null,notas:'',photo:null} with Bearer bim_token from localStorage.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs; only minor code-quality suggestions above.
